HomePage.description: A secure and transparent digital platform established by the Ministry of Mining to receive, track, and resolve public complaints and feedback related to mining activities. Empowering citizens, improving service delivery, and strengthening governance through accountability.

ComplaintPage.title: Submit a Complaint
ComplaintPage.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to submit your complaint. Provide accurate and complete information to help us process your complaint efficiently.

details.title: {category} Details
details.personConcernedPlaceholder: Enter the name of the person concerned
details.descriptionPlaceholder: Provide a detailed description of your {category}
details.requestedActionPlaceholder: Specify the action you would like to be taken
details.evidencePlaceholder: Upload any supporting documents or evidence

tips.title: Complaint Tips
items: Be clear and concise in your description.
Attach any supporting documents if necessary.
Provide your contact information for follow-up.
Incomplete or unclear complaints may take longer to process.
